question: In July 2025, which initiative was launched to promote workplace wellness for women in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahila Aarogyam Kaksh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Mahila Aarogyam Kaksh** initiative was launched in **July 2025** to promote **workplace wellness for women** in India.
 
• This program focuses on creating **healthier work environments** by addressing physical, mental, and emotional well-being among women employees.
 
• It is aimed at ensuring that women, particularly in organized and unorganized sectors, have **access to essential health resources** and support systems.
